author: Mark Banchereau
title: Young Africans turn to agriculture as alternative to urban life
description: Farming has long been seen as low-status work across much of Africa, pushing young people to cities in search of office jobs. But the high cost of living and lack of job opportunities are pushing some youth to give agriculture another try. Thousands of people…
